description.value:
Cost 2 Hit Points

Frequency once per day

Pay Hit Points instead of devotion for a point of Zeal.

Gain 1 Zeal, which may exceed your normal maximum by 1 point; excess is lost after 1 minute. Paying in blood instead of devotion works just as well, for now.

cinderfall.incomplete: The entire mechanical content of this card is a Zeal cost/gain/regain clause. cultist.bargain.json's own system.rules is [{"key":"ChoiceSet",...},{"key":"GrantItem",...}] -- no SpecialResource or resource-pool rule element of any kind is defined anywhere in this class for Zeal, confirmed via pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/special-resource.ts's own shape (a permanent, one-way-only-increases resource track) and a direct read of the class card. Every "Cost N Zeal"/"gain N Zeal"/"regain spent Zeal" clause in this class is unbuildable regardless of the rest of that card's content, since there is no resource for a rule element to reference.
